deficits.evidence: No footway visible on the left side of the road, pedestrians walking in the roadway
deficits.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: No footway visible on the right side of the road, pedestrians walking in the roadway
deficits.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk along the right side of the road to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: Marked pedestrian crossing is obstructed and hard to see due to parked vehicles and lack of kerb ramps
deficits.suggestion: Install raised platforms and clear the crossing area of obstructions to improve visibility and ensure drivers stop for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: No kerb ramps at the marked pedestrian crossing
deficits.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at the pedestrian crossing to facilitate safe access for pedestrians, including those with disabilities.

ratings.reason: The left side lacks a proper footway, and a sidewalk is a standard feasible improvement.
The right side lacks a proper footway, and a sidewalk is a standard feasible improvement.
The crossing is clearly obstructed by parked cars, and the suggested measures address this specific layout.
The kerb is high and lacks ramps at the crossing, making the suggested installation feasible and appropriate.
